absolution.text: God, the Father of mercies, through the Death and Resurrection of his Son has reconciled the world to himself and poured out the Holy Spirit for the forgiveness of sins; through the ministry of the Church may God grant you pardon and peace. And I absolve you from your sins, in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.
absolution.notes: Revised US English translation, in force from Ash Wednesday 2023. USCCB prints the last sentence in capitals (the essential form). The Criterion printed 'absolve you of your sins', a misprint against the USCCB text.
